Lecture Overview:
Why do AI agents forget, and how do you give them memory? In this Stanford CS329Z: Engineering AI Agents lecture, Michael Ryan explains the four types of agent memory (working, episodic, semantic, procedural), how to store memories in files, databases, or knowledge graphs, and the main architecture patterns: skill libraries like Voyager, tiered memory like MemGPT, reflective consolidation, and memory maintenance with A-MEM and Mem0. He closes with memory benchmarks and open problems in forgetting, privacy, and over-personalization.
